run.decision: FAIL / MATCHED TOTAL-RETURN AUDIT DOES NOT CONFIRM ROBUST QUAL QUALITY ALPHA. QUAL remains directionally better than matched SPY: evaluation CAGR 13.069187% vs SPY 13.008582% and Sharpe 1.480549 vs 1.470548, with 5/7 fold Sharpe wins and slightly lower MDD 7.379394% vs 7.384346%. However paired 20,000-replicate bootstrap gave P(CAGR QUAL>SPY)=75.190% and P(Sharpe QUAL>SPY)=83.945%, both below the frozen 90% gates; cumulative 42-candidate DSR=88.967%<95%. Therefore robust_strategy_pass=false. The earlier ATM-SVP2-US-MQ-ROLE-002 QUAL result remains truthful against the original price-index comparator but cannot support a quality-premium/product promotion after matched total-return correction. QUAL may remain visible only as an explicitly labeled research experiment; its prospective promotion interpretation is suspended. No SPY/QUAL blend, timing, alternate start, ETF replacement, threshold, or comparator rescue is permitted.
